morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中整词作为词根处理，不拆成 ne- + layan；首音节 e 为弱元音 /ə/，y 读作 /j/。

senses.zh_definition: 渔民；以捕鱼为业的人，DBP 所列核心义特指在海上捕鱼的人。
senses.en_definition: A person who catches fish at sea, especially for a living.
senses.nuances: 重点在捕鱼的职业或生计身份；休闲垂钓者通常称 pemancing。nelayan 不标明性别。nelayan pantai 指在近岸海域捕鱼的渔民。核心定义及近岸用法见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=169476&keyword=nelayan)。

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 社区发展汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Program latihan itu bertujuan meningkatkan kemahiran keselamatan nelayan ketika bekerja di laut.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该培训计划旨在提高渔民在海上作业时的安全技能。
dual_scenarios.en: The training programme aims to improve fishers' safety skills when working at sea.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Nelayan kat jeti tu dah balik ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah nelayan di jeti itu sudah pulang?
dual_scenarios.zh: 那个码头的渔民回来了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Have the fishers at that jetty come back yet?
spoken_features: tu 和 dah 分别对应 itu 和 sudah。
句末 ke 表示口语询问；nak 对应 hendak。

messages.speaker: Mei Ling (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Nelayan kat jeti tu dah balik ke? Aku nak beli ikan.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah nelayan di jeti itu sudah pulang? Saya hendak membeli ikan.
messages.zh: 那个码头的渔民回来了吗？我想买鱼。
messages.en: Have the fishers at that jetty come back yet? I want to buy some fish.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, jom pergi sekarang. Ikan baru sampai ni.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, mereka sudah pulang. Mari kita pergi sekarang kerana ikan baru sahaja sampai.
messages.zh: 回来了，咱们现在去吧。鱼刚到呢。
messages.en: Yes, let's go now. The fish have just arrived.

etymology.historical_story: The DBP entry places nelayan in a recognisably coastal world: its central meaning is a person catching fish at sea. It also records nelayan pantai for those working near the shore. This cultural setting helps learners connect the word with a livelihood. The supplied evidence does not establish its historical source language. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=169476&keyword=nelayan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 ne-la-yan 三拍读，脑中同步播放“登船—撒网—收鱼”三个动作，把整词与渔民联系起来；不要拆成 layan。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: nelayan 是中性的职业名称。直接称呼某位渔民时，使用其姓名、合适的称谓或对方惯用称呼，比单独用职业名称招呼更自然。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合新闻、职业介绍和渔业讨论。不要把渔民身份等同于贫困、教育程度低或某个族群；购买鱼获时也应尊重劳动和正常议价边界。
